news.title: Opinion: Infectious disease expert: The mysterious pneumonia in Russia deserves attention, not panic
news.summary: Chill out about reports about plague in Siberia, writes infectious disease doctor Krutika Kuppalli.

news.title: STAT+: AstraZeneca opens new Boston site
news.summary: AstraZeneca opened a new R&D site in Kendall Square yesterday, celebrating a $1 billion investment in the unsettled center of U.S. biotechnology after a spate of Chinese dealmaking.

news.title: STAT+: Are stem cell treatments about to have their day?
news.summary: Stem cells might be the next peptides, and how Trump's $90 checks will play out after the election.

news.title: What are hospital longevity programs, and what can they tell you about your health?
news.summary: What can hospital longevity clinics can tell you about your health? STAT's Sarah Todd went to one to find out.

news.title: STAT+: FDA spells out 2027 AI guidance plans
news.summary: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: New AI guidances expected from the the FDA in 2027, Utah expanding its AI sandbox, and more.

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about U.S.-funded psychedelic trials, an AstraZeneca R&D center, and more
news.summary: The Trump administration is advancing the first government-funded clinical trials of the psychedelic drug ibogaine to treat opioid addiction and PTSD

news.title: Deciding when to get your flu shot? Consider these factors
news.summary: When’s the best time to be vaccinated? Here are some thoughts that may help you make your decision.

news.title: In this hospital, pulse oximeters went from overestimating to underestimating blood oxygen. Why?
news.summary: Researchers found pulse oximeters went from overestimating blood oxygen levels to underestimating them; inaccuracies were worse in patients of color.

news.title: Opinion: I’m a doctor. Here’s what I want the public to know about AI tools and health care costs
news.summary: “We can document honestly and still wind up inflating hospital bills,” writes a frustrated doctor.

news.title: Opinion: Why the FDA should not approve an ineffective multicancer screening test
news.summary: “Telling more people they have cancer is not progress; progress is having fewer people die from cancer,” H. Gilbert Welch writes of Grail’s multicancer screening test.

news.title: STAT+: Can you live longer for $5,500? Longevity clinics are the buzzy new trend at nonprofit hospitals
news.summary: Longevity clinics promise personalized health advice and cutting-edge tests. Now major hospitals are entering the business, at costs reaching $45,000 a year.

news.title: STAT+: Judges skewer HHS arguments in hearing over Medicare Advantage audits lawsuit
news.summary: Federal judges pushed back against the government's arguments in a Medicare Advantage case.

news.title: STAT+: Nobel-winning optogenetics research has led to experimental treatments for blindness and Alzheimer’s
news.summary: Optogenetics is now the foundational way through which we are able to understand how the brain works

news.title: STAT+: New Trump regulations would clean up health care pricing disclosures
news.summary: The Trump administration is continuing its effort to bring more transparency to the cost of health care.

news.title: STAT+: Prices, prices, prices
news.summary: Why is health insurance so expensive? Read the latest stort in STAT's "Out of Pocket, Out of Reach" series to find out.

news.title: Intermountain stepping back from clinically integrated network jointly run, owned with UCHealth
news.summary: The nonprofits had launched Trinsic in 2023 as a push toward value-based care and improved care coordination. UCHealth will be its sole owner and operator come December.

news.title: Lawmakers press CMS to roll back proposed restrictions on remote patient monitoring
news.summary: A bipartisan group of 32 House lawmakers is pressing CMS Administrator Mehmet Oz to reconsider proposed Medicare payment rule changes that would restrict how remote patient monitoring services are staffed and delivered.

news.title: Highmark taps Karen Hanlon as CEO, David Holmberg to transition to executive chairperson
news.summary: Highmark is making a change at the top, with Karen Hanlon stepping into the role of CEO on Jan. 1.

news.title: CD&R, McKesson acquiring infusion therapy provider Option Care Health for $5.8B
news.summary: Option Care Health, the country's largest independent provider of at-home and alternate site infusion services, would go private in the deal, which is expected to close in the first half of 2027.

news.title: Vitalize secures $31M to scale AI-powered operating system for hospital staffing and scheduling
news.summary: Vitalize positions its software as an "air traffic control" system for healthcare operations, helping health systems automate staffing, forecast demand, manage capacity and reduce reliance on overtime and agency labor.

news.title: Proposed nuclear safety rules threaten to stall Novartis’ Pluvicto expansion
news.summary: Novartis’ flagship radioligand therapy Pluvicto entered a rapid growth phase recently, driven by FDA approvals in earlier-stage prostate cancer and broader uptake in community settings. But a regulatory overhaul proposed by federal nuclear authorities now threatens to derail that momentum, potentially raising administrative hurdles that experts say could force clinics to rethink patient care while deterring others from adopting the therapy altogether.

news.title: Healthcare Dealmakers—Minnesota health system mergers, Grindr's HIV telehealth push and more
news.summary: HealthPartners and Essentia Health unveil 22-hospital combination, Waystar go-private reports and more healthcare merger and acquisition news from September.

news.title: Trinity Health improves to 1.1% operating margin in FY2026
news.summary: The 91-hospital system credited volume gains and greater rates for its 5.2% operating revenue growth and expense management, including a reduction in full-time equivalents and checked cost growth "well below the medical rate of inflation."

news.title: Texas AG Ken Paxton launches investigations into UnitedHealth Group, BCBSTX
news.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton announced on Monday that he would launch an investigation into industry giant UnitedHealth Group for "engaging in deceptive and unlawful practices" that may have denied care to Texans.

news.title: FTC sends price transparency warning letters to 24 large hospital systems
news.summary: Letters sent Monday warn that CMS guidances on price transparency are "a regulatory floor." Hospitals are also subject to the FTC Act's prohibitions on unfair or deceptive marketplace practices, which could apply to incomplete or inaccurate pricing information, the regulator said.

news.title: CMS finalizes updates to price transparency regulations that aim to improve usability
news.summary: The Trump administration on Monday finalized a rule that aims to make the data files mandated under price transparency regulations more usable.

news.title: White House to dispense Part B rebates to more than 20M enrollees
news.summary: On the heels of news that the White House would offer rebates to nearly 1 million people enrolled in Affordable Care Act plans, the Trump administration said Monday that it will pay out $90 rebates to more than 20 million Medicare Part B enrollees.

news.title: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig halts development of lead fusion protein in rare autoimmune disease
news.summary: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig Therapeutics has halted one of the two trials for its sole clinical asset after determining the program wouldn’t be able to advance quickly enough.

news.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval for new CardioMEMS HF System that allows heart readings to be seen at home
news.summary: Abbott has been given U.S. clearance for new updates to its CardioMEMS HF System that allow for patient-facing capabilities through its CardioGuide HF App.

news.title: Biotech’s peptide shows promise as ‘bait molecule’ to treat neuropathic pain in mice
news.summary: While psychedelic drugs may be capturing all the attention when it comes to finding fresh ways to treat neuropathic pain, research with mice has suggested a peptide approach may also be effective.

news.title: ArriVent’s phase 3 lung cancer trial flops, sinking stock
news.summary: A phase 3 lung cancer study of ArriVent BioPharma’s EGFR inhibitor has missed its primary endpoint, sending the biotech’s stock down 57% in early trading on the Nasdaq.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: KymaThera corrals $80M; RougeTx lifts off with $58M
news.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

news.title: Kairos seizes moment to push prostate cancer prospect into earlier setting
news.summary: Kairos Pharma is moving prostate cancer prospect ENV-105 into an earlier line of treatment in response to midphase survival data.

news.title: Forbion’s ‘landmark’ €2.3B fundraise to benefit 30 ‘high potential’ biotechs
news.summary: Forbion has touted its “landmark” 2.3 billion euro ($2.6 billion) fundraise across two funds as a new record for the European life sciences-focused VC firm.

news.title: UK unveils new policy to constantly monitor AI-based medical devices
news.summary: The U.K.’s drug and medical technology regulatory body the MHRA will continually monitor all artificial intelligence-based devices.

news.title: How NIH’s Nicole Kleinstreuer is working to reduce animal testing while avoiding a ‘backlash’
news.summary: In the past 18 months, the National Institutes of Health has been working overtime to push new policies to reduce animal testing with the help of one woman at the helm: Nicole Kleinstreuer, Ph.D.

news.title: AstraZeneca hopes to ‘achieve amazing things’ with new Kendall Square R&D center
news.summary: AstraZeneca executives touted the benefits of further establishing themselves in Massachusetts’ biopharma “ecosystem” as the Big Pharma opened a new R&D center.

news.title: TRex Bio stomps toward $111M IPO, as Retension and Lycia also gear up to go public
news.summary: Eli Lilly-backed TRex Bio is aiming for a $111.3 million IPO, while hypertension-focused Retension Pharmaceuticals hopes for a more modest $33.8 million and protein degradation biotech Lycia Therapeutics plans its own listing.

news.title: Genentech pays Alector $100M for preclinical Parkinson’s prospect
news.summary: Genentech is paying Alector $100 million upfront for exclusive rights to a preclinical drug candidate that targets a driver of neurodegeneration in Parkinson’s disease.

papers.title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
papers.summary: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. papers.title: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
papers.summary: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. papers.title: Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation
papers.summary: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. We introduce two learned latent protein languages. Protein Latent Language (PLL) maps sequences to a 4,096-state contextual alphabet built on a frozen ESM-2 encoder, with one token per residue.
